mods.name: ParCool x Sable
mods.description:
Makes ParCool! parkour work on Sable physics structures (Create: Aeronautics ships).

Wall running, wall jumping, wall sliding, ledge grabbing, climbing, vaulting, bar
hanging and diving all understand blocks that live inside a Sable sub-level, not
just blocks sitting in the main world.

Supports both ParCool generations. Version 4 is a rewrite with a different
detection layer, so this mod carries two separate sets of hooks and enables
whichever matches the ParCool that is installed.

Designed to stay out of the way: it does nothing at all when there is no ship
near the player, so every other ParCool addon behaves exactly as it did before.

releases.notes:
# GitHub release 1.2.0

Tag: `v1.2.0`   Title: `ParCool x Sable 1.2.0 - ParCool 4 support`
Attach: `build\libs\parcoolxsable-1.21.1-1.2.0.jar` (not the `-sources` one)

Everything between the two rules below is the release body. Paste it as is.

---

Adds support for **ParCool 4.0.x**, alongside 3.4.x. One jar — it picks the right
set of hooks when the game loads, from the ParCool you actually have installed.

ParCool 4 is still an alpha, and it is a rewrite rather than an update, so its
internals move between builds. This is built against **4.0.0.2**. Nothing here is
pinned: hooks that stop matching simply do not apply, so a later alpha loses
features rather than breaking the game.

**Requires** [ParCool!](https://modrinth.com/mod/parcool) and
[Sable](https://modrinth.com/mod/sable). With either missing the mod disables
itself quietly, so it is safe to leave installed.

### ParCool 4

ParCool 4 is a rewrite, not an update, so this is a second set of hooks rather
than a port of the first.

Most of what ParCool 4 asks the world is "is this box clear?", and correcting
those answers is enough. Three actions don't ask that at all — they push a box
and see where it stops:

- **Hanging** finds the ledge under your hands this way. This is the one that
  matters: without it, a hull never stops the box, and the grab is refused
  however good the handhold looks.
- **HangDown** finds the bar over your head.
- **Vault** finds the railing.

So the mod walks the motion itself and reports where the ship first gets in the
way.

### New on both versions

- **Pole climbing** — masts, chains, runs of fence posts.
- **Scuff particles** on ParCool 4. Without them a run along a deck threw no dust
  at all, which reads as the deck not really being there.
- **Bars point the right way on a turned ship.** A block state carries direction,
  and ParCool reads it as a world direction — on a yawed hull those disagreed, so
  a bar swung about the wrong axis. Ship blocks are now turned into world
  orientation before ParCool sees them.
- **Jumping off a deck no longer gets caught.** The grip assist reaches further
  than ParCool does, which is the point of it, but the same reach could grab you
  on the way out. It now lets go once you're moving away from the hull faster
  than the new `releaseSpeed` option — measured relative to the ship, so a fall
  doesn't count and neither does a hull flying past you.
- **Sloped and banking hulls are handled exactly**, with a separating-axis test
  instead of the axis-aligned approximation used before. The box drawn around a
  rotated box is up to 70% fatter at a 45° bank, and a fatter probe reads clear
  air as solid — felt as a grab that fires early on one side of a listing hull
  and is refused on the other.

### Worth knowing

- With no ship nearby it does nothing at all, so ParCool on the ground behaves
  exactly as it does without this installed. A real world wall always wins over a
  ship one.
- The `sweptCollision` option is gone. Delete it from your toml or let it be
  rewritten.
- Friction from ship blocks is a ParCool 3 feature. ParCool 4 doesn't check wall
  friction at all, so there is nothing to correct there.
- [ParCool+ / Compatibility Addon](https://github.com/semillakan6/ParCool-CompatibilityAddon-NeoForge)
  by **semillakan6** patches some of the same ParCool 3 methods; the two use
  different injection points and coexist. Its Sable support is gated to ParCool 3,
  so on ParCool 4 there is nothing to overlap with.
- If ParCool moves something in a future version, this goes inert rather than
  crashing the game.

Built on top of [ParCool!](https://github.com/alRex-U/ParCool) by **alRex-U** and
[Sable](https://github.com/ryanhcode/sable) by **ryanhcode**. Neither is
affiliated with this project — bug reports about it belong here, not there.

Tested against ParCool 1.21.1-3.4.3.3 and 1.21.1-4.0.0.2, Sable Companion 1.6.0,
NeoForge 21.1.233.

mods.description:

releases.notes:
First release. Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge.

Makes ParCool parkour work on Sable physics ships. Wall running along a hull,
wall jumping, wall sliding, grabbing a deck edge, climbing up, vaulting,
hanging from rigging and diving all work now, including on sloped and curved
plating and on a hull that is banking or pitching.

Sable keeps ship blocks in a hidden area far off the map and only draws them at
the ship's position, so ParCool was checking empty air where the ship looked
like it was. This projects the player into the ship's coordinate space, runs the
same checks there, and rotates the result back.

**Requires** [ParCool!](https://modrinth.com/mod/parcool) and
[Sable](https://modrinth.com/mod/sable). With either missing the mod disables
itself quietly, so it is safe to leave installed.

### Worth knowing

- With no ship nearby it does nothing at all, so ParCool on the ground behaves
  exactly as it does without this installed. A real world wall always wins over
  a ship one.
- Hooks use MixinExtras, which stack with other mods' handlers instead of
  fighting them. ParCool+ / Compatibility Addon uses no mixins at all, so
  nothing to clash with there.
- Create's super glue and honey are untouched. The mod only reads blocks; the
  one thing it writes is the player's own velocity while clinging.
- If ParCool renames something in a future version, this goes inert rather than
  crashing the game.

Config lives in `config/parcoolxsable-common.toml` — reach and slope tolerance
for the grip assist are tunable there, and it can be switched back to ParCool's
strict flat-wall rules.

Built on top of [ParCool!](https://github.com/alRex-U/ParCool) by **alRex-U** and
[Sable](https://github.com/ryanhcode/sable) by **ryanhcode**. Neither is
affiliated with this project — bug reports about it belong here, not there.

Tested against ParCool 1.21.1-3.4.3.3, Sable Companion 1.6.0, NeoForge 21.1.233.

Full details in the [README](https://github.com/Argorice/ParcoolXSable#readme).
Русская версия: [README.ru.md](https://github.com/Argorice/ParcoolXSable/blob/main/README.ru.md).
